content.issue: Canonical lifecycle status was ready while execution-state was running, preventing attempt-resume, transition to working, and direct transition to review.
content.resolutionCondition: Use manager-owned lifecycle transitions to reach review while preserving the current revision, attempt, outcomes, evidence, and worktree.
content.resolutionEvidence: The Work Unit manager completed ready -> backlog -> blocked -> review, preserved revision 1 attempt 1 and all passing outcomes, and changed execution-state to review.
evidence: attempt-resume requires a working Work Unit
transition to working requires attempt-start or rework-start
invalid Work Unit transition: ready -> review
